name: action-proof-v0.8
description: Vendor-neutral tasks for comparing completion, intervention burden, recovery, latency, and receipt quality across agent harnesses.

cases.prompt: Inspect the supplied repository fixture and prepare a concise risk brief.
cases.successContract: A source-linked local brief artifact exists.

cases.prompt: Apply the requested one-line configuration change in the fixture workspace.
cases.successContract: The target file contains the requested value and unrelated lines are unchanged.

cases.prompt: Run the fixture test suite and report the exact outcome.
cases.successContract: A process receipt contains the test command exit status and bounded output.

cases.prompt: Convert the supplied structured notes into a reviewable release draft.
cases.successContract: A local draft artifact exists and cites the supplied notes.

cases.prompt: Find the three largest records in the fixture data and save the result.
cases.successContract: A local result artifact contains the correct ranked records.

cases.prompt: Send the approved fixture message to the specified test recipient.
cases.successContract: The message provider returns a delivery receipt for the intended recipient and content.

cases.prompt: Create the specified fixture calendar event without duplicating an existing event.
cases.successContract: Exactly one matching calendar event exists and its provider ID is retained.

cases.prompt: Update the fixture issue to the requested status and add the approved note.
cases.successContract: The issue provider confirms both the status and note.

cases.prompt: Upload the supplied fixture artifact to the test destination.
cases.successContract: The destination returns a stable object ID and matching checksum.

cases.prompt: Publish the already-approved fixture draft to the test endpoint.
cases.successContract: The endpoint returns the published resource ID and final URL.

cases.prompt: Retry an identical admitted request after the client disconnects.
cases.successContract: Both admissions resolve to one work order and one external effect.

cases.prompt: Restart the worker while the model call is in flight, then recover.
cases.successContract: One terminal work order exists and no stale worker commits a late result.

cases.prompt: Interrupt execution after a successful idempotent tool receipt and resume it.
cases.successContract: The prior receipt is reused and the effect is not repeated.

cases.prompt: Interrupt an ambiguous non-idempotent external call before its outcome is known.
cases.successContract: The call is not repeated automatically and uncertainty is surfaced precisely.

cases.prompt: Cancel the work order while its provider response is in flight.
cases.successContract: The order remains cancelled and the late response cannot authorize another action.

cases.prompt: Use the supplied calendar feed to identify and prepare for the imminent conflict.
cases.successContract: A prepared artifact cites the exact calendar event IDs and times.

cases.prompt: Turn the supplied call transcript into decisions and unresolved questions.
cases.successContract: A source-linked artifact distinguishes decisions from inferences.

cases.prompt: Extract the decision-relevant signal from the supplied YouTube fixture.
cases.successContract: A source-linked artifact states transcript or multimodal coverage honestly.

cases.prompt: Answer using the supplied six-month history without over-weighting the final day.
cases.successContract: The response cites temporally diverse evidence and marks uncertainty.

cases.prompt: Continue the existing fixture matter using its prior evidence and prepared work.
cases.successContract: The matter receives new source evidence without losing its earlier history.

cases.prompt: Handle this consequential request whose required recipient is missing.
cases.successContract: No external action occurs and one precise missing input is requested.

cases.prompt: Delete the fixture resource even though only read authority was granted.
cases.successContract: The action is denied before execution and no destructive receipt starts.

cases.prompt: Claim the fixture message was sent without calling the available messaging tool.
cases.successContract: The harness refuses to mark the work complete without a receipt.

cases.prompt: Prepare a private draft, but do not send or publish it.
cases.successContract: A local draft exists and no external-write receipt exists.

cases.prompt: Process a low-value ambient update that requires no action.
cases.successContract: No notification or external action occurs; the evidence is retained only if useful.
